portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously-released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

This update is available via the Red Hat Network. Details on how to
use the Red Hat Network to apply this update are available at
http://kbase.redhat.com/faq/docs/DOC-11259
portal_description:
The hwdata package contains tools for accessing and displaying hardware
identification and configuration data.

This update adds the following enhancements:

* The pci.ids database has been updated to include the information about the
MegaRAID SAS Thunderbolt device. (BZ#662673)

* The pci.ids database has been updated to include the information about the
Matrox IMMv2 management controller and integrated MatroxG200eR video controller.
(BZ#633837)

Users of hwdata are advised to upgrade to this updated package, which adds these
enhancements.
